dashboard.settings.autoAcceptHelp: Orders are confirmed automatically. If the requested slot is full, the order moves to the first free slot. It is confirmed only when there is capacity. Orders with notes from the customer (e.g. an allergy) still have to be confirmed manually.
dashboard.settings.layoutHelp: How items appear on the “Add order” screen.
dashboard.settings.layoutTabsHelp: Shows one category at a time. Tap a category to switch to it. Best for long menus, where every item stays in the same place.
dashboard.settings.layoutScrollHelp: Shows all items in one scrolling list, with a heading for each category. There are no category buttons — you move by scrolling. Best for short menus, where you see most of it at once.
dashboard.settings.paidStepHelp: Adds a “Confirm” button when you add an order yourself, so you record it now and take the payment later.
dashboard.settings.takesCashHelp: Splits the payment button into “Cash” and “Card”.
dashboard.settings.orderReadyHelp: Shows the “Mark as ready” button on the orders screen. Kitchen screens (KDS) are set separately. Customers get an email whenever an order is marked as ready.
dashboard.settings.buzzerPromptTitle: Remind me to add a buzzer
dashboard.settings.buzzerPromptHelp: Opens the buzzer grid as soon as you record an order, so the number shows on the dashboard while the customer is still in front of you. When it is off you can still add a buzzer any time by tapping the order, but nothing will remind you. Useful where you hand out buzzers, easy to turn off where you don’t.
dashboard.settings.cardsHelp: Turn it off during a card problem and customers will order as usual but pay on collection. Orders keep coming; only the card step stops.
dashboard.settings.cardsScope: This applies to your whole food truck, on every event, and stays off until you turn it on again.
dashboard.settings.soundsHelp: The on/off switch is on each screen; each device controls its own sound.
